The write-off states are this service's own record inside `WriteOffWorkflow`, and rwb-case moves the case state on the published outcome; the split of the state between this service and rwb-case is an open question with the P3 owner, so that no state has two writers (GAP-1800). Payment matching after charge-off is not run here: the match is the `ProceedsMatched` event (EV-25) published by rwb-payment, the recovery, the income and the agency fee are recorded in this service, a payment that matches nothing is held in the exception list shown here, and the ownership of the initial match is an open question with the P8 owner (GAP-1812). The hand-over of a charged-off population to the debt sale route is carried here as product behaviour, with the population, the route and the approval recorded here; the call type and its direction are an open question with the S6 owner before wave 4 system test (GAP-1799).

The write-off read and the write-off sale operation are not published, so the population is asserted through the case read, the decision record and DP09, and the handover is driven by the lot operation that S6 publishes.
